description: Defines the MergedCellList class which manages a list of table cells, including initialization from a table, neighbor detection, and border calculations for rendering purposes in formats like RTF and PDF.

classes.name: MergedCellList
classes.description: A list managing merged table cells, providing border calculations and neighbor detection for rendering.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the list from a table, adding cells and handling merged cells.

methods.name: IsAlreadyCovered
methods.description: Checks if a cell is already covered by a previous merged cell.

methods.name: GetEffectiveBordersRtf
methods.description: Returns borders for RTF rendering, considering heading rows.

methods.name: GetEffectiveBordersPdf
methods.description: Returns borders for PDF rendering, considering heading row repetitions.

methods.name: GetEffectiveBordersInternal
methods.description: Core method to determine effective borders based on neighboring cells and rendering context.

methods.name: GetCoveringCell
methods.description: Finds the cell that covers a given cell due to merging.

methods.name: GetBorderFromBorders
methods.description: Creates a border object inheriting properties from a given borders object.

methods.name: GetEffectiveBorderWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a border at a specific position.

methods.name: GetNeighborTop
methods.description: Finds the top neighbor cell, optionally overriding the row index for heading repetitions.

methods.name: AddHeaderInsertionRowIndex
methods.description: Records the index of a row after inserting a heading for border calculations.

methods.name: GetLastKnownHeaderInsertionRowIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted heading row index.
